findings.description: Common revisions archive previous root and full dependency closure; bounded lineage, legacy revision gap preserved, no silent pruning
Nested Pinned closures validated with independent scope and depth/expansion limits; renderer uses definition identity, no hidden live substitution
Scoped export/import retains common and hotel archives; recursively collect/remap styles in closed snapshots; assets remain recursively closed
Pinned Detach resolves actual revision; unsafe transforms fail closed and nested dependencies remain pinned
Common Properties selects current or archived revision; explicit relink and revision change; nested pin in common draft with dependency validation; no reactive re-layout

limits: Archive captures dependency closure at supersession time, not a fabricated reconstruction of earlier historical dependency states
Bounded 12 common archives, 8 MB combined, 2 MB per pin; refuse overflow, never prune
Nested pin requires live reference available for explicit relink and conservative combined graph validation
Pinned detach only at safe untransformed unit scale with resolvable child live definitions; exact font/glyph and appearance parity unverified
No standalone module or schema/native change; A13 runtime regression and A14 source follow-up remain open
